name: Smile Auth
description: Your Smile Auth 2FA codes and passwords, end-to-end encrypted. Log in from the login box and fill codes in one click.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; connect-src https://auth.smilecraft.fun https://api.pwnedpasswords.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self' https: http:; require-trusted-types-for 'script'; trusted-types 'none'
